description.value: Azur Legacy Collection Hotel is a 5-star luxury boutique property in downtown Vancouver, and the first and only hotel in Western Canada to join the Leading Hotels of the World. The Art Deco-inspired building houses 104 rooms, suites, and penthouses across 14 floors, with a lobby restaurant (Dahlia) and a rooftop Middle Eastern restaurant and skybar (Lavantine) on the 14th floor. It sits in the heart of the Financial District, a short walk from the waterfront and Stanley Park.
